revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - The new reading in lin6 is good, and the decision not to interfere with lin15 is sensible. Before finalizing, add accents to ὀμνυντες (7), [α]ὐ̣τον and παραστησομεν (11), [αὐ]τον (12), ἐπερωτηθεντες and ὡμολογησαμεν (14). In lin13 write τοῦτο, even if it's corrected to τούτου.
Submit - Corrections of DDbDP typos, integration of BL, regularization, and one new correction.

Commit - DDbDP typos in lin13 τῷ => ed. pr. has το (l. τῷ); lin15 ὑπατείας <:τῆς προκειμένης (?)|reg|μετα τη ν ὑπατείαν:> => μετὰ τὴν ὑπατείαν̣ (ὑπατείας τῆς προκειμένης is a tentative interpretation in BL 9.83, which I didn't include). I've integrated BL 9 for lin2 removing [Φαρμοῦθι <#ιγ=13#> (?)], and BL 11 for lin3-4: προπ̣[ο]λ̣ι̣|τ[ευ]ο[μ]ένῳ as well as BL 1 for the same. In lin3 I've regularized Ἀσυνκριτίῳ (l. Ἀσυγκριτίῳ), and in lin6 I've added one correction of a ghost-epoikion Πατελκίου => Παπλώου (well-attested). This change affects the restoration of the epoikion's name in P.Lond. 3 1246 lin5.
Second automated transfer of accents across reg-orig pairs
Automated transfer of accents across reg-orig pairs
